title: Umananda Temple

buildingCutout.basis: The principal mapped island temple outline.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified public relief field sampled at the middle of the temple footprint.

mapIdentity.provider: The mapped temple polygon opposite the named Umananda Mandir point and approach path. The adjacent island and individual map features were checked against the two cleared Qualla photos.
mapIdentity.scope: Five-vertex mapped temple footprint, named site marker and two exact July 2024 aerial photographs from Qualla. Original Copernicus relief sampled before authoring.

note: A ribbed white sanctuary dome and red finial behind a flat-roofed entrance hall, an adjacent ribbed red shrine, and a raised stone and brick court.
